about.description: Degree families a visitor may hold, in a fixed order (the position is the bit in the profile code). es: the label in Spanish. stems: regex fragments over lower-case, accent-free text, used both to read the degrees a CV holds and the degree an advert demands. 'engineering-any' is the generic 'an engineering degree' an advert asks for without naming the field. APPEND ONLY.
